name: @vsor/sor-site-e2e
description: The browser tier of specs/sor-site/surface/spec.md (B5-B15). Assembles the materialized shape — the forked shell (packages/sor-site/app) as siteDir, the vsor init scaffold as its site/, fixtures/tiny as its knowledge/ — builds it normally and with B12 sentinels, serves both statically, and runs the Playwright acceptance. Driver: run.sh (invoked by `make surface`). It declares no runtime dependency of its own: everything the assembled site imports is declared by ../app and hoisted into the workspace's node_modules, so this file cannot drift from what the shell actually needs. Deliberately has no `test` script: the suite only makes sense against the servers run.sh starts.
